limitations: 功能摘要根据作者固定版本材料归纳，不是逐字引文或独立效果验证。

evidence.summary: 核查 packages/dsh-task-board/README.md、packages/dsh-task-board/cordis.patch.yml、packages/dsh-task-board/src/index.ts、packages/dsh-task-board/src/client/index.ts、packages/dsh-task-board/src/host-runner.ts、packages/dsh-task-board/src/host-service.ts、packages/dsh-task-board/src/host-ledger.ts、packages/dsh-task-board/src/host/agent-tools.ts、packages/dsh-task-board/src/host-routes.ts；宿主账本接受手动与定时触发，执行器绑定工作区、预设和权限后才提示会话。
limitations: 核对本机看板的挂载、权限、定时、子卡和代表性访问路径；未安装，未核宿主兼容矩阵、跨机器执行或独立 GitHub 扩展。
只执行本工程的统计和结构验证；没有执行目标插件、测试、安装或真实宿主验收。
GitHub/npm 活跃度只作采集背景，未核实独立用户采用或同条件收益对照。

findings.text: 适合要反复做仓库检查、希望用同一张卡管理会话与运行记录的 DSH 用户，见 [Q01](#research-q01)。
宿主账本接受手动与定时触发，执行器绑定工作区、预设和权限后才提示会话。
核对本机看板的挂载、权限、定时、子卡和代表性访问路径；未安装，未核宿主兼容矩阵、跨机器执行或独立 GitHub 扩展。
宿主入口和 Web 客户端来自同包不同导出，补丁插入看板；发布包与当前提交未核实同源。

#### 成本

| 阶段 | 现金与资源成本 | 人工与时间投入 | 已知条件与未知项 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 首次 | 宿主和模型环境 | 设置工作区及权限 | 未知工时 |
| 持续 | 常驻主机与模型请求 | 复核卡片输出 | 每份合格结果费用未知 |
| 失败恢复 | 可能再次产生模型费用 | 核对错过或未开始的记录 | 停机不会补跑 |
先开一次只读卡，确认关闭浏览器后宿主能触发并保留实际会话输出。出现跳过或输出无法核验时停止排期，见 [Q04](#research-q04)。

#### 效果

| 效果项 | 当前证据支持 | 尚不能确定 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 定时执行 | 宿主账本与计时器 | 实机稳定性 |
| 子卡 | 父会话调度与继承记录 | 独立完成率 |
运行器显式拒绝没有工作区或权限未确认的情况，定时恢复不补跑停机触发。继承结论应作为不同证据来源处理，见 [Q02](#research-q02) 与 [Q03](#research-q03)。
把工作区、会话执行与定时记录归在一张卡，并让宿主继续运行任务，见 [Q01](#research-q01) 和 [Q02](#research-q02)。
子卡可能只继承父会话结果。停机触发点也会跳过，应分别核对运行和计划记录，见 [Q02](#research-q02) 与 [Q03](#research-q03)。
在子卡状态旁展示独立运行和继承结论的来源，盲评能否减少误验收，见 [Q05](#research-q05)。

#### 启动与依赖

| 依赖或条件 | 是否必需 | 用途 | 缺失或不满足时 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| DSH Web 和宿主会话服务 | 必需 | 管理卡与创建会话 | 无法启动任务 |
| 有效工作区、预设和权限 | 执行时 | 绑定实际运行条件 | 失败或待确认 |
| liangshen 预设 | 有未完成子卡时 | 让父会话调度 | 缺失则拒绝 |

technical.rationale: 看板与定时器都已有直接替代，增量在于统一账本、会话绑定及权限失败门槛。账本设计可迁移到有会话 API 的宿主，但受定时及运行接口依赖约束，简化主要是操作入口。

business.rationale: 把原来分别配置、运行和查结果的工作改为同一张卡，提供可追溯记录。已有 DSH 用户受益，新增群体证据薄弱。常驻与模型成本仍在。

recommendation.reason: 已有 DSH Web 且要定期检查仓库的开发者，可以先为一个只读检查设置一次触发。相比手动重开会话和找日志，卡片会把触发、工作区及结果关联起来。若计划被跳过、绑定需提权或输出无法独立核验，就关闭计划并回到手动检查。

scenario.rationale: [Q01](#research-q01) 与 src/host-runner.ts 565–585 说明重复开会话和查记录的具体摩擦，超过 50%，缺直接需求数据止于 75%。

advantage.rationale: [Q02](#research-q02) 的 src/host-service.ts 1027–1085 给出宿主单计时器与跳过，实质改变触发和追查，超过 50%。子卡继承和宿主停机限制使 100% 不成立。

evidence.rationale: [Q02](#research-q02) 与 [Q03](#research-q03) 核查了执行、权限和失败分支，超过仅入口的 25%，没有同版运行验证，止于 50%。

cost.rationale: [Q04](#research-q04) 只读单次规则可以停用并人工替代，超过 25%，但运行宿主、账单和验收有明确负担，未到 75%。

data.reports:
# DSH Task Board > 在 DSH Web 管理任务卡、真实会话执行和宿主定时计划。 ## 研究范围 - **仓库**：[zhu1090093659/dsh-web](https://github.com/zhu1090093659/dsh-web) - **版本号**：0.4.16（[固定提交 971cc3e1f6f5b52bbcd86802a9be0e0c50fc32f1](https://github.com/zhu1090093659/dsh-web/tree/971cc3e1f6f5b52bbcd86802a9be0e0c50fc32f1)） - **版本日期**：2026-11-12（固定提交日期，北京时间；不是包发布日期） ## 结论状态 源码支持宿主执行与计划恢复策略；任务合格率、主机兼容及长期费用尚无实测。 ## 洞察短评 - **用途**：适合要反复做仓库检查、希望用同一张卡管理会话与运行记录的 DSH 用户，见 [Q01](#research-q01)。 - **亮点**：把工作区、会话执行与定时记录归在一张卡，并让宿主继续运行任务，见 [Q01](#research-q01) 和 [Q02](#research-q02)。 - **思考**：子卡可能只继承父会话结果。停机触发点也会跳过，应分别核对运行和计划记录，见 [Q02](#research-q02) 与 [Q03](#research-q03)。 - **建议**：在子卡状态旁展示独立运行和继承结论的来源，盲评能否减少误验收，见 [Q05](#research-q05)。 采用建议：先开一次只读卡，确认关闭浏览器后宿主能触发并保留实际会话输出。出现跳过或输出无法核验时停止排期，见 [Q04](#research-q04)。 ## 核心贡献 把工作区、会话执行与定时记录归在一张卡，并让宿主继续运行任务，见 [Q01](#research-q01) 和 [Q02](#research-q02)。 ## 关键质疑 子卡可能只继承父会话结果。停机触发点也会跳过，应分别核对运行和计划记录，见 [Q02](#research-q02) 与 [Q03](#research-q03)。 ## 重点创新推演与最小验证 在子卡状态旁展示独立运行和继承结论的来源，盲评能否减少误验收，见 [Q05](#research-q05)。 安排一次低权限试触发，分别模拟关浏览器和停宿主，核对卡片、计划和会话输出。 ## 场景与替代办法 适合要反复做仓库检查、希望用同一张卡管理会话与运行记录的 DSH 用户，见 [Q01](#research-q01)。 简单提醒用宿主自动化，稳定的脚本仍可用 CI，人工推理任务则用原会话和检查清单。 ## 依赖与流程 #### 启动与依赖 | 依赖或条件 | 是否必需 | 用途 | 缺失或不满足时 | | --- | --- | --- | --- | | DSH Web 和宿主会话服务 | 必需 | 管理卡与创建会话 | 无法启动任务 | | 有效工作区、预设和权限 | 执行时 | 绑定实际运行条件 | 失败或待确认 | | liangshen 预设 | 有未完成子卡时 | 让父会话调度 | 缺失则拒绝 | #### 启动步骤 | 步骤 | 执行者与动作 | 成功判据或失败处理 | | --- | --- | --- | | 准备 | 创建只读测试卡 | 已确认工作区 | | 触发 | 安排一次并保留宿主在线 | 确认实际创建会话 | | 收尾 | 检查输出或停用规则 | 无独立输出则人工重跑 | ## 成本与效果 #### 成本 | 阶段 | 现金与资源成本 | 人工与时间投入 | 已知条件与未知项 | | --- | --- | --- | --- | | 首次 | 宿主和模型环境 | 设置工作区及权限 | 未知工时 | | 持续 | 常驻主机与模型请求 | 复核卡片输出 | 每份合格结果费用未知 | | 失败恢复 | 可能再次产生模型费用 | 核对错过或未开始的记录 | 停机不会补跑 | #### 效果 | 效果项 | 当前证据支持 | 尚不能确定 | | --- | --- | --- | | 定时执行 | 宿主账本与计时器 | 实机稳定性 | | 子卡 | 父会话调度与继承记录 | 独立完成率 | ## 研究问题与完整回答 **插件研究总目标**：验证卡片怎样在宿主触发真实会话，以及权限、失期和子卡结算对采用的限制。 ### Q01 · 定时卡片相比原生自动化页面有什么任务增量？ **研究主题**：场景与需求、贡献与相对优势 #### 完整回答 适用场景是反复运行仓库检查并希望把工作区、提示词和结果留在一张卡片上的开发者。作者说明官方自动化仍承担提醒或定时提示。固定源码中，这个扩展挂载独立看板并由宿主建立账本服务，执行器会实际创建、命名会话并提示。已用 CI 稳定执行的机械命令仍适合留在 CI。看板更适合需要会话推理和核对运行记录的检查，合格结果是会话输出满足任务规则并可追溯。 #### 证据与依据 **依据 1 · 作者声明**：[packages/dsh-task-board/README.md:24-32](https://github.com/zhu1090093659/dsh-web/blob/971cc3e1f6f5b52bbcd86802a9be0e0c50fc32f1/packages/dsh-task-board/README.md#L24-L32) 作者解释官方自动化与看板的职责。 ```text ## Features Cards keep multi-line title and description previews with visible metadata. Previews strip Markdown formatting; task details render description and prompt as safe Markdown without raw HTML or automatic remote images, and content taller than about eight rendered lines is clamped to a fixed height with a fade hint and a "Show more" toggle that expands and collapses it, while shorter content renders untouched with no toggle. Stored task text is unchanged. A bracketed title prefix such as `[Bug]:` renders as a type badge, and the description preview skips issue-form boilerplate (checkbox lists, section headings, empty-field placeholders), preferring a summary section when one exists. A left stripe shows the latest run (running, succeeded, failed, cancelled); a card whose column disagrees with that run is labelled as set by hand. Each column shows the time its cards differ by — created in Backlog/To Do, started while running, settled in Done/Failed — read in the Host time zone. The latest execution session opens straight from the card. Every column header toggles compact single-line cards (Done starts compact, the choice is stored in the browser). All five columns and the archive first group cards by provider source — full `owner/repository` labels for GitHub — with unclaimed cards in Local tasks; source groups sort by label and their fold choices persist per browser. Done source groups start collapsed while the other columns and the archive start expanded, and search always reveals matching groups. Done, Failed and the archive nest Today / Last 7 days / Earlier within each source group and fold the oldest group once that source holds more than 30 cards, unless a search is active. - **Task board UI**: the board is the shell's own center-column panel — like the desktop application's Plugins page, it contributes a row to the shell's official sidebar panel list and a page to the layout's center-column seat, so row geometry, the active highlight, the collapsed rail, the label, and language switching are the shell's to own; the board provides five kanban columns, search, task details, archive/restore, execution history, and links to execution transcripts. Every column is reachable by hand, by dragging a card or from the detail view's move menu: the move writes the column and no execution record, so Done or Failed declares work that finished (or failed) outside a tracked run and Running parks work that is under way without a session, while a card the runner is actually executing refuses every move until it settles. Archived tasks are read-only except for restore, delete, and transcript viewing, and cannot run manually or on schedule until restored. - **Two complementary automation entries**: the shell's official *Automation tasks* page manages reminders and timed prompts in the Host Schedule service, while *Task board* manages cards, subtasks, real Session execution, cron, and execution history. Both entries stay available so the user can choose the task shape; the board neither hides nor takes over the official page. - **Detail layout and folds**: the task detail is two columns on a wide viewport — the left holds the task itself (description, execution prompt, labels, subtasks, frozen snapshot, handover bundle) and the right holds how this run will run (execution settings, scheduled runs, execution history, status); a narrow viewport falls back to one column in the same order. Workspace, agent preset, permission, model, and reasoning effort stay visible, while session reuse (continue in the same conversation) folds into one "Run Mode" row that echoes whether it is enabled while closed, so the card's shape is readable without expanding it. Scheduled runs and execution history each take one fold row: the schedule row says whether a rule is armed and when it next fires, the history row says how many runs there are and what the latest one did, and the list itself shows the five most recent runs until it is expanded. The permission gate and the current status never fold. The view uses three type sizes (title, body, meta), status and result badges share one filled slot scale, and every fold row and button carries a hit target of at least 44 pixels. - **Continuation cards (data plane)**: a new task may paste a `<<>>FREEZE` block from a session; it parses into a goal/progress/next snapshot persisted with the task (ledger v3). Cards carry a frozen badge, the detail view shows the full snapshot and freeze time, search covers snapshot text, and archive/restore matches plain tasks. The snapshot reuses the freeze security gate at the protocol layer: sensitive patterns become `[REDACTED]` with a marker, slash-prefixed command lines reject the whole snapshot, and each field is capped at 8 KiB. - **Handover bundles and the permission confirmation gate**: a continuation card may attach a handover bundle — the pinned execution triplet (workspace / agent preset / permission) plus doc/script references. The bundle's triplet overrides the plain pin fields at execution, and the references ride the prompt as a handover preamble. A binding whose effective permission is above the deployment's permission baseline — the Host's own default permission preset unless the profile pins `sessionDefaultPermission` — is unconfirmed: manual run refuses, cron skips the card and rolls to the next occurrence, and the confirm button in the task detail resolves the binding; any later permission or bundle change re-arms the gate. ``` **依据 2 · 源码核查**：[packages/dsh-task-board/cordis.patch.yml:6-12](https://github.com/zhu1090093659/dsh-web/blob/971cc3e1f6f5b52bbcd86802a9be0e0c50fc32f1/packages/dsh-task-board/cordis.patch.yml#L6-L12) 宿主和浏览器实际挂载。 ```text # The row is a bare plugin by package name: the node half (exports ".") runs # in the host process (the system-prompt announcement section), and the # `dsh.client` declaration in package.json makes the browser half # (exports "./client", served at /plugins//client.js) load in the web GUI. - insert: - id: ui-task-board name: '@linxin666/dsh-client-ui-task-board' ``` **依据 3 · 源码核查**：[packages/dsh-task-board/src/index.ts:619-635](https://github.com/zhu1090093659/dsh-web/blob/971cc3e1f6f5b52bbcd86802a9be0e0c50fc32f1/packages/dsh-task-board/src/index.ts#L619-L635) 构造 Host 看板服务和依赖。
查看原文（17行） ```text const host = new TaskBoardHostService(ctx.typertGateway, { workspaceRegistry: ctx.workspaceRegistry, ownerPeer, sessionDefaultPermission, maxSubtaskDepth: maxSubtaskDepth(), runLaunchWidth, spendBudgetTokens, cardDefaults, modelCatalog, attachments: () => resolveAttachmentStore(ctx), modelInfo: () => resolveModelInfoReader(ctx), legacyAgentTeams, timers: resolveHostTimers(ctx), commandDispatcher: { async execute(sessionId, line, signal) { const agent = await resolveExecutionAgent(ctx, sessionId) return (await ctx.commands.execute(agent, line, [], signal))?.result ```
**依据 4 · 源码核查**：[packages/dsh-task-board/src/client/index.ts:401-408](https://github.com/zhu1090093659/dsh-web/blob/971cc3e1f6f5b52bbcd86802a9be0e0c50fc32f1/packages/dsh-task-board/src/client/index.ts#L401-L408) 注册面板。 ```text // panel selection is reconciled back into the controller so the board's own // view state follows the user clicking another panel row. try { disposers.push(registerTaskBoardPanel(ctx, controller)) const layoutFace = ctx.get('layout') as { panelInfo?: { subscribe(listener: () => void): () => void; getSnapshot(): { activePanelId: unknown } } } | undefined if (layoutFace?.panelInfo !== undefined) { const sync = (): void => { const active = layoutFace.panelInfo!.getSnapshot().activePanelId ``` **依据 5 · 源码核查**：[packages/dsh-task-board/src/host-runner.ts:565-585](https://github.com/zhu1090093659/dsh-web/blob/971cc3e1f6f5b52bbcd86802a9be0e0c50fc32f1/packages/dsh-task-board/src/host-runner.ts#L565-L585) 为卡片实际开会话并提示。
查看原文（21行） ```text } // Nothing names a workspace and the deployment has none to resolve to, so // there is no place this run may legitimately start: `session.create` would // quietly land it in the Host process working directory (the desktop app's // profile directory). Refuse before the session exists, with the reason the // board settles the card with and the browser renders in the user's // language, so the fix (pick a workspace on the card) is what the user reads. if (workspaceId === undefined) throw new Error(MISSING_WORKSPACE_REASON) const created = await this.invoke('session', 'create', { workspaceId, ...(mode === undefined ? {} : { agentPreset: mode }), }) as { sessionId: ExecutionSessionId } const sessionId = created.sessionId options.onSession?.(sessionId) try { await this.invoke('session', 'rename', { sessionId, title: task.title }) await this.pinAndPrompt(sessionId, task, permission, options.promptContext, options.catalog) } catch (error) { throw new SessionLaunchError(sessionId, error) } return sessionId ```
#### 缺口 - 未比较已有 CI 或宿主任务的长期维护量 **影响**：无法估算迁移收益 **进一步探讨**：以同一仓库巡检比较结果追溯和人工介入 ### Q02 · 手动和定时启动怎样绑定权限与宿主运行条件？ **研究主题**：功能与机制、工程质量与复用 #### 完整回答 宿主用最近到期规则决定单个定时器，恢复时跳过停机期间的旧触发点。迟到超过容差也会走恢复，故关浏览器和关宿主结果不同。触发通过账本申请运行，运行器检查工作区后创建会话，权限命令必须确认成功才继续。仓库卡绑定超过默认权限时账本进入待确认条件。模型工具能显示此条件，确认仍需通过 UI 的人工流程。已启动的模型请求和插件关闭后的最终状态仍应核对运行记录，代码不能证明宿主之外的工作恰好一次完成。 #### 证据与依据 **依据 1 · 源码核查**：[packages/dsh-task-board/src/host-service.ts:1027-1085](https://github.com/zhu1090093659/dsh-web/blob/971cc3e1f6f5b52bbcd86802a9be0e0c50fc32f1/packages/dsh-task-board/src/host-service.ts#L1027-L1085) 到期、迟到和跳过规则。
查看原文（59行） ```text * Boot / resume recovery: skip every occurrence that came due while the * board was not running and roll each schedule to its next future target, * then arm the timer for the nearest one. The board marks parent and subtask cards, the detail view lists the direct subtasks and says what one run will do, and the header offers a one-click hide-subtasks filter. - **Parent-card dispatch and subtask accounting**: clicking a card that carries unfinished subtasks opens that card's own session and nothing else. The run is forced under the `liangshen` dispatcher preset shipped by `packages/dsh-liangshen`, the card's stored agent preset is never rewritten, and session reuse is skipped so the run mints a fresh session; a deployment that registers no `liangshen` preset fails the run closed, with that missing preset as the reason on the card, and so does a deployment running the legacy Agent Teams runtime, where that preset cannot orchestrate and would stop to await a reply an unattended run never gets: the run is refused before any session exists, and the card carries the reason naming the exit. The prompt names every unfinished subtask with its title, task id, and status, states that no session is opened for them, and asks the session to read each card with `task_board_get`, dispatch it with `subagent` in dependency order (independent ones may run together), and write each conclusion back with `task_board_manage({action:'record-external-outcome'})` before it finishes. A conclusion the session never wrote back is supplied by the Host when the card's own run ends: every still-unrecorded unfinished subtask inherits that verdict as an external record whose initiator reads `parent-run:` and whose reason says the card ran no session of its own and inherited the parent run's conclusion. The backfill is idempotent, and a cancelled parent writes nothing.
